inputs.text:
A solitary small natural floating island with one large ancient sky tree, in the upper-right of a portrait fantasy game background. The tree has risen into the air and its roots have pulled a small piece of earth and rocks along with it. Keep the beautiful tree shape, fresh green canopy, rich painterly style and quiet cloudy blue atmosphere of the reference. Refine the suspended terrain to make this concept unmistakable.

The small landmass has an ORGANIC IRREGULAR rounded outline with uneven broken edges, a grassy top with tiny white and yellow wildflowers, warm exposed soil and small weathered mossy stones. It is compact compared to the broad lush tree crown. Large gnarled brown roots visibly grow out of the trunk, wrap around the broken rocks along BOTH sides of the island, weave under the clump and hold the rocks together like a natural woven basket. There are many different root thicknesses and natural crossings. The underside is a rough roundish cluster of roots, soil and rocks, with several long thin roots hanging freely below. Natural curved roots hug angular broken stones. Not a clean geometric shape, no triangular slab, no perfectly straight cut, no pointed symmetrical cone. The rock does not descend like a whole mountain; this is only a small piece of ground carried by the tree.

One large warm-brown twisting trunk rises from the grass, supporting a grand layered canopy of luminous yellow-green and lime leaves with deep forest-green shaded undersides. Maintain the beautiful layered broadleaf crown, branching silhouette and warm sunlight from upper-left. The tree is much larger than the small island. A high three-quarter bird's-eye camera looks DOWN onto the grass and exposed roots, with the roots beneath still visible along the near edge. Put the island toward the upper-right and let a little outer foliage extend out of the top-right edge. The island and its root mass end in the middle-upper portion of the frame, with plenty of open cloud-filled sky below and to the left for a separate foreground vessel that is not drawn.

Soft white cloud banks drift FAR BELOW through clear blue atmospheric depth. This is a remote lonely natural place, with only this single tree and tiny piece of land, no signs of habitation. Premium polished hand-painted 2D fantasy mobile RPG art, rich detailed roots and bark, softly sculpted leaf clusters, fresh living greens, warm ochre earth, blue-gray natural rocks, crisp organic silhouettes and quiet airy distance. No nearby islands or mountains, no ships, no buildings, no people, no ocean or water surface, no flags or cargo, no path, no text, no UI, no border, no watermark. A natural irregular root-bound island, beautiful large sky tree, clear lower-left space, calm clouds beneath.
